title: Kitano shopping list, format version 1
description: A weekly shopping list exported by the Kitano meal planner. See docs/shopping-list-format.md. Consumers must ignore properties they do not know.

formatVersion.description: The major version of the format. A consumer rejects a version it does not support.

createdAt.description: When the list was exported, as an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp.

version.description: The CalVer version of the planner, "local" for a local build, or null when unknown.

language.description: The BCP 47 language of the names, labels, and categories.

recipes.description: The planned recipes the list was made from, once each, for reference.

excludedRecipes.description: Optional. The planned recipes that the user left off the shopping list, once each. Their ingredients are not in items.

items.description: The shopping-list totals, in the order of the planner's shopping list.

name.description: The normalized ingredient name: lowercase and singular where the planner knows the singular. Use it as the key to match products.

quantity.description: The total quantity, or null when the recipes give no amount (for example "zout").

optional.description: True for the extra amount that recipes list as optional. A needed amount of the same ingredient is a separate item.

category.description: The Dutch shopping category of the planner.

label.description: The Dutch text of the item as the planner displays it, for people.

unit.description: The normalized unit, for example "gram", "ml", "liter", "stuk", "el", "tl", "teen", or "blik". A consumer treats a unit it does not know as not convertible.
